name: Only the Roots Remain
source:
A new soul pops into existence; Sapling. Across the way, an old, soul resides; Oak. Behind them stands a strong tree, a symbol of their connection. How far do the roots go?

[From [url=https://silverdesign.itch.io/only-the-roots-remain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一缕新的灵魂诞生了，名叫树苗。在另一边，住着一缕古老的灵魂，名叫橡树。他们身后矗立着一棵茁壮的大树，象征着彼此的联系。树根究竟延伸到多远的地方？

[摘自[url=https://silverdesign.itch.io/only-the-roots-remain]Itch.io[/url]]
